frontMatter.value: Refines a raw idea the owner brings into a sharp, actionable concept through structured divergent and convergent thinking: sharpening questions, five to eight variations, two or three directions stress-tested, the hidden assumptions named and a not-doing list, in a one-pager in the reply. Use when an idea is still vague, before any change, or when the owner wants to expand options before converging on one; on "ideate" or "refine this idea".

passages.text: idea-refine is a trial start for an idea the owner brings that is still vague, before any change. It runs as a conversation in the reply, edits no file, and needs no mode and no record. It differs from what-to-build, which proposes ideas from the repository's own evidence: here the idea is the owner's, in the request's own words. A direction the owner takes up becomes a change like any other: propose its mode and wait, as AGENTS.md says, open its record with a `## start` section carrying the one-pager's problem statement, direction, assumptions and not-doing list, and run the line from `frame`.
passages.reason: The opening in the start's own voice: when the block's situation sends an agent here, that the conversation edits no file, how it differs from what-to-build, and a direction taken up becoming a change under an approved mode, its record's start section carrying the one-pager.

## Handoff

Consumes: the owner's idea, in the request's own words; the repository, when the idea sits inside one
Produces: the one-pager in the reply: the problem statement, the recommended direction, the key assumptions, the MVP scope and the not-doing list; nothing durable until the owner's yes
Next: frame, under the mode the owner approves, for a direction the owner takes up
